description: Marseille - Wifi public is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Marseille. Sites d'implantation des points Wi-Fi publics de la Ville de Marseille avec indication de la zone couverte, adresse et géolocalisation. Plus d'informations:. Coverage: Ville de Marseille. The portal shows the English title as "Marseille - Public Wifi" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ville de Marseille. Its keywords include wifi, coordonnees-gps. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
